title: Implement MMS driver
objective: Implement Method of Manufactured Solutions driver in verify/convergence.py. Given manufactured u*(x) = A sin(πx/L)cos(πy/L)sin(πz/L), compute corresponding body force b* = -Div(P*), solve on mesh sequence, measure L2 and H1 errors.
implementation_steps: Define manufactured displacement u*(x,y,z) = A*sin(πx/L)*cos(πy/L)*sin(πz/L) symbolically with SymPy
Compute F* = I + grad(u*), C* = F*^T F*, E* = 0.5*(C* - I)
Compute b* = -Div(P*) symbolically via SymPy differentiation
Solve on mesh sequence using ref_hex8_elastic.py::generate_hex8_mesh()
Compute L2 error = sqrt(integral of |u - u*|^2) and H1 error = sqrt(integral of |grad(u) - grad(u*)|^2)
Return errors and mesh sizes for check_convergence_rate()
acceptance_criteria: Body force b* is correct (verified by substitution check)
L2 error decreases with mesh refinement
For Hex8 (p=1): L2 rate ≥ 2.0, H1 rate ≥ 1.0
risks: Risk: symbolic differentiation of P* may be extremely slow for 3D nonlinear kinematics. Mitigation: cache the lambdified body force, use CSE in SymPy.
Risk: mesh generation at fine levels (8^3 = 512 elements) may be slow. Mitigation: keep to 3 levels maximum, mark test @pytest.mark.slow.
